decisions.reason: A versatile piqué upholstery fabric close to the core offer that still has its own website page is likely to stay in the collection for another season.
Flame-retardant curtain fabrics meet steady contract and hospitality demand, and this one keeps its own website page, so it remains a durable collection item.

Its wool content fits the sustainability direction, but its lower website visibility and the earlier withdrawal of similar bouclé and wool items raise the risk, so it is kept for now under closer review.
Launched only in 2024 with its own page and usable for both upholstery and curtains, it is far too new to withdraw.
